  • Served in SOFTWARE INDUSTRIES at various positions from application developer to Project Manager and in EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS at various positions from Faculty, Assistant Professor, Professor, Head, Vice Principal to Principal, Dean, Director and Registrar In-charge. Possess strong personality traits, excellent communication and interpersonal skills & high quality of learning and teaching.
  • Served as an Accreditation head for NBA and NAAC accreditation process. Chief architect of bringing standard documentation formats and SSR. Served as an IQAC head and helped the Institution in improving academic quality by bringing standard quality process.
  • Developed an automated system for attainment computations for supporting OBE process.
  • My PhD research carried out at Visvesvaraya Technological University and developed a FRAME WORK FOR CORPORATE MANAGEMENT SYSTEM USING BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE The prime focus of this work., Involves, development of an integrated predictive collaboration performance evaluation frame work. Secondly, a method for Performance measurement of collaboration process to monitor and reporting. In these KPIs of individual companies includes to the development of cKPIs and real-time process performance analysis. Finally, developed and deployed a computer software system using Business Intelligence for online project evaluation purpose.
  • Established Center of excellence in collaboration with Toyota Kirloskar. Cars are not the only part of the automotive industry to become a part of the Internet of Things. Roads and infrastructure are also connected to a common network to enhance interaction. Some of the benefits of smart cities and other IOT technologies include: Traffic jams and congestion prevention, intelligent road lighting, Smart parking management, Network charging stations for electric vehicles, and Proper energy management. Students and research scholars of various disciplines leverage the facility to conduct project and research on any of these areas.
  • Responsible for solar & wind energy highbred power generator commissioning. Students and research scholars of various disciplines leverage the facility to conduct project and research on highbred power. Students of CS developed an APP to monitor the energy level and consumption.
  • Served as chief coordinator for various technical and cultural activities, also responsible to architect events like national level paper presentations and project exhibitions.
  • Served in large enterprises and has successfully coordinated a wide variety of complex Projects with working knowledge of Support Solution, Providing Product Operations Solutions. Outstanding records for exceeding targets consistently for the last couple of years.
  • Served as QA Engineer and responsible for all quality activities, including managing the ISO9001:2000 Quality Management System and other Certification Scheme
  • Served at various levels in supporting for project management and application software development in the fields of Project analysis, Requirement Study, Feasibility Study, Project design, Preparation of Functional Spec, Preparation of Program Specification, Program development, System Maintenance, Quality Assurance. Sit, Regression, UAT, PAT Testing and Production Implementation Under Various systems mainly ECS/ECS+/GCMS (MC)/TRAMS /ESSENTIS/VISA VAP for Western European region countries, Asia pacific region countries, CEEMEA and Mexico regions.
  • Possess a very strong ability in design and developing complex solutions associated with SAS and its related technologies.
  • Configuration management (CM) - Possessed Vast experience in establishing and maintaining consistency of a system's or product's performance and its functional and physical attributes with its requirements, design, and operational information. Identifying the functional and physical attributes of software at various points in time, performing systematic control of changes to the identified attributes for the purpose of maintaining software integrity and traceability throughout the software development life cycle.
  • Release Management- Possessed good knowledge and served as Facilitator to ensure smooth and timely delivery of software products or updates, supports production systems/applications, and takes responsibility for their implementations.
